title: EC60082: Lightwave Networks
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Pre-requisites: EC61103Evolution of optical networking: long-haul point-topoint terrestrial and transoceanic links, LAN and broadband access segments;
Fibre optic LANs: Suitable topologies and MAC protocols, FDDI, DQDB, Gigabit
Ethernet; Fibre optic SANs: ESCON, Fibre channel, HIPPI; Review of SONET/SDH
and concepts of networking using IP-over-ATM-over-SONET/SDH architecture; WDM
networks: Elements of WDM networks Ã¢ÂÂ Optical line terminals, Optical line
amplifiers, Optical add/drop multiplexers (OADMs), Reconfigurable OADMs,
Optical crossconnects; WDM backbone networks: Concepts of wavelength routing
and lightpaths, Lightpath topology design, Routing and wavelength assignment,
LP-based optimum design and heuristic algorithms, Wavelength conversion,
Traffic grooming in wavelength-routed backbones; IP-over-WDM and GMPLS;
Survivable optical networks: Protection in SONET/SDH, Protection in WDM
backbone networks - dedicated and shared schemes; Optical access networks:
Hybrid fiber coax (HFC), Enhanced HFC, Fibre to the curb, Passive optical
networks; Optical burst switching: Concepts of offset time and just-enough time
(JET) switching, node architectures. Optical CDMA: Basic concept and
applications.
